skills.label: Account
skills.desc: Check the email, organization, role, and seat tier on your Claude for Government account, who to ask to change each one, and what to do with no seat.

skills.label: Sessions
skills.desc: See every place you are signed in to Claude for Government, sign any of them out, and check how long sessions last and what ends them.

skills.label: Usage
skills.desc: Check how much of your Claude allowance you have used and when it resets, and what to do when you hit a usage limit or your organization runs out of credits.

skills.label: Your account
skills.desc: Check your own account details, usage limits, and active sessions in the Claude for Government web portal.

skills.label: Available settings
skills.desc: Config page settings in Claude for Government, such as session timeouts, network and folder access, tool approvals, connectors, plugins, telemetry, and updates.

skills.label: Connectors
skills.desc: Connectors let tenant administrators and organization owners add their agency's MCP servers: who gets them, authentication, OAuth redirect URIs, tool policy.

skills.label: How Config works
skills.desc: Config levels in Claude for Government: how tenant, directory group, and organization settings combine, what locks do, and when changes reach members.

skills.label: Manage plugins and connectors
skills.desc: Upload plugins and skills in Claude for Government: archive rules, size limits, the Runs code marker, install behavior, updates, and removal.

skills.label: Set up the Microsoft 365 connector
skills.desc: Register a Microsoft Entra application for the Microsoft 365 connector in Claude Desktop, choose its read and write permissions, and fix sign-in errors.

skills.label: Connect Claude Code to Claude for Government
skills.desc: Connect the Claude Code command-line tool to Claude for Government with managed settings on macOS, Windows, and Linux, and confirm a device is set up.

skills.label: Connect Claude Desktop to Claude for Government
skills.desc: Connect Claude Desktop to Claude for Government: the bootstrap URL, device profiles for macOS, Windows, and Linux, network hosts, updates, and troubleshooting.

skills.label: Deploy Claude for Microsoft 365 in Claude for Government
skills.desc: Download the Claude for Microsoft 365 manifest from your Claude for Government host and deploy the add-in to users from the Microsoft 365 admin center.

skills.label: Windows fleet checklist
skills.desc: Windows device, MSIX installer, application control, and virtualization checks to make before you deploy Claude Desktop for Claude for Government.

skills.label: Import your data from Claude for Government Web
skills.desc: Copy your conversations, projects, and files from Claude for Government Web into Claude Desktop, or move your Claude Desktop data to another computer.

skills.label: Models in Claude Desktop
skills.desc: Switch models in Claude Desktop on Claude for Government, see what the 1M context window does, and find what controls which models you see.

skills.label: Plugins in Claude Desktop
skills.desc: Find, install, create, and remove plugins in Claude Desktop for Claude for Government, and understand what plugins add in this deployment.

skills.label: Skills in Claude Desktop
skills.desc: Skills in Claude Desktop for Claude for Government: where they come from, how to create and manage your own, and how administrators distribute them.

skills.label: Video walkthroughs for Claude Desktop
skills.desc: Watch short narrated walkthroughs of signing in to Claude Desktop with Claude for Government, bringing your work over, and finding your way around the app.

skills.label: Analytics
skills.desc: Review your organization's requests, tokens, spend, active users, top users, and credit balance over time, and download the data as CSV files for reporting.

skills.label: Billing
skills.desc: See the balance your organization spends from, the spend caps set on it, and its seats, and what happens as the billing account's balance runs low.

skills.label: Compliance API
skills.desc: Stream your organization's audit events into a SIEM or log management system.

skills.label: Config at the organization level
skills.desc: Set product settings for everyone in your organization on the Config page, and see how connectors and plugins inherited from your tenant behave there.

skills.label: Group mappings
skills.desc: Map directory groups to seat tiers and roles in your organization, and see how mappings are applied and what a deactivation in your directory does.

skills.label: Organization administration
skills.desc: Manage the people, seats, and settings for a single organization within your agency: users, roles, seat tiers, usage, billing, and Config.

skills.label: Readiness
skills.desc: Readiness checks for your organization: what the checks on credits, spend caps, seats, seat tiers, models, and products mean, and who can clear each one.

skills.label: Seat tiers
skills.desc: Seat tiers set which Claude models a user can access and how much they can spend. Organization owners create and manage their own seat tiers.

skills.label: Seats
skills.desc: See how many seats of each tier your organization holds and how many are assigned, and how new and unassigned users get a seat tier.

skills.label: Setup wizard
skills.desc: Setup wizard for a new organization: how to open it, and what the seat tiers, seats and credits, products, and finish steps cover.

skills.label: Users
skills.desc: Find a user, change their role or seat tier, sign them out everywhere, deactivate or reactivate them, reset their usage limits, and see what each role can do.

skills.label: Claude for Government administrator guide
skills.desc: Set up and manage Claude for Government for your agency: how tenants, organizations, users, seats, and credits fit together.

skills.label: Claude for Government changelog
skills.desc: Release notes for Claude for Government

skills.label: Moving from Claude for Government Web
skills.desc: Find answers to the questions agencies ask most often when moving from Claude for Government Web to Claude Desktop.

skills.label: Video walkthroughs for administrators
skills.desc: Watch short narrated walkthroughs of setting up and running Claude for Government for your agency.

skills.label: Security and data handling
skills.desc: Review how Claude for Government handles data: sandbox isolation, network traffic, approvals, connector credentials, telemetry, web search, and local storage.

skills.label: Admins
skills.desc: Tenant administrator access: what it grants, who can be added, how to add or remove an administrator, and the safeguards on the list.

skills.label: Billing
skills.desc: See each billing account's credit balance and set per-organization spend caps, with what a cap counts, what it stops, and when a change takes effect.

skills.label: Config at the tenant level
skills.desc: Set tenant-wide defaults for product behavior, lock settings so organizations can't change them, and preview how a change affects each organization.

skills.label: Identity and access
skills.desc: Verify domains, connect single sign-on and SCIM, write the routing rules that place people in organizations, and look up what a sign-in error page means.

skills.label: Organizations
skills.desc: See every organization in your tenant, open an organization's admin view, add an organization and get it ready for people, and copy user email addresses.

skills.label: Readiness
skills.desc: Readiness checks for your tenant and its organizations: what the checks on domains, routing rules, sign-in failures, and billing mean, and who clears them.

skills.label: Seats
skills.desc: Divide each billing account's seat pool among the organizations it funds, and see who can change an allocation and why a change is refused.

skills.label: Tenant administration
skills.desc: Manage the settings that apply across your whole agency: organizations, identity and sign-in, and how seats are distributed and spend caps are set.

skills.label: Tenant restrictions
skills.desc: Restrict which Claude for Government tenants can be reached from your agency's network by having your network proxy inject an allowlist header.

skills.label: Tenant setup wizard
skills.desc: Set up a new tenant in order: verify a domain, connect single sign-on, add an organization, give it seats, and add the routing rule that lets people sign in.
